chunks.heading: Credit transfer application
chunks.text:
Credit transfer application
Students interested in credit transfer should check the official Kathmandu University website for active credit transfer or Expression of Interest (EOI) notices before applying.

chunks.heading: Application form
chunks.text:
Application form
Applicants must complete the designated credit transfer or Expression of Interest (EOI) application form. The form is typically provided through the official admission notice or an online application link.

chunks.heading: Required documents
chunks.text:
Required documents
Applicants should prepare the required documents, including official academic transcripts and grade sheets from their previous or foreign university, course syllabi or descriptions for equivalence evaluation, and a copy of their student ID along with a citizenship certificate or passport.

chunks.heading: Document submission
chunks.text:
Document submission
Completed applications and supporting documents should be submitted to the relevant department, school office, or through the online application link specified in the official credit transfer notice.

chunks.heading: Application review
chunks.text:
Application review
Kathmandu University reviews each credit transfer application individually. The university evaluates subject equivalence, credit matching, and any examination requirements before making a final decision.
